# awscc_glue_ml_transform (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Glue::MLTransform



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A user-defined, long-form description text for the machine learning transform.
- `glue_version` (String) The version of AWS Glue this machine learning transform is compatible with.
- `input_record_tables` (Attributes) A list of AWS Glue table definitions used by the transform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_record_tables))
- `max_capacity` (Number) The number of AWS Glue DPUs allocated to task runs for this transform.
- `max_retries` (Number) The maximum number of times to retry after an MLTaskRun fails.
- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the machine learning transform.
- `number_of_workers` (Number) The number of workers of a defined workerType that are allocated when a task runs.
- `role` (String) The name or ARN of the IAM role with the required permissions.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags to use with this machine learning transform.
- `timeout` (Number) The timeout in minutes of the machine learning transform.
- `transform_encryption` (Attributes) The encryption-at-rest settings of the transform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform_encryption))
- `transform_id` (String) The unique identifier for the transform.
- `transform_parameters` (Attributes) The algorithm-specific parameters that are associated with the machine learning transform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform_parameters))
- `worker_type` (String) The type of predefined worker that is allocated when a task runs.

<a id="nestedatt--input_record_tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_record_tables`

Read-Only:

- `glue_tables` (Attributes List) The database and table in the AWS Glue Data Catalog that is used for input or output data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_record_tables--glue_tables))

<a id="nestedatt--input_record_tables--glue_tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_record_tables.glue_tables`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_id` (String) A unique identifier for the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
- `connection_name` (String) The name of the connection to the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
- `database_name` (String) A database name in the AWS Glue Data Catalog.
- `table_name` (String) A table name in the AWS Glue Data Catalog.



<a id="nestedatt--transform_encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform_encryption`

Read-Only:

- `ml_user_data_encryption` (Attributes) The encryption-at-rest settings of the transform that apply to accessing user data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform_encryption--ml_user_data_encryption))
- `task_run_security_configuration_name` (String) The name of the security configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--transform_encryption--ml_user_data_encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform_encryption.ml_user_data_encryption`

Read-Only:

- `kms_key_id` (String) The ID for the customer-provided KMS key.
- `ml_user_data_encryption_mode` (String) The encryption mode applied to user data.



<a id="nestedatt--transform_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `find_matches_parameters` (Attributes) The parameters to configure the find matches transform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform_parameters--find_matches_parameters))
- `transform_type` (String) The type of machine learning transform.

<a id="nestedatt--transform_parameters--find_matches_parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transform_parameters.find_matches_parameters`

Read-Only:

- `accuracy_cost_tradeoff` (Number) The value for accuracy and cost tradeoff. A value of 0.5 means balance.
- `enforce_provided_labels` (Boolean) If true, forces the output to match the provided labels.
- `precision_recall_tradeoff` (Number) The value for precision and recall tradeoff. A value of 0.5 means no preference.
- `primary_key_column_name` (String) The name of a column that uniquely identifies rows in the source table.
